referenceControl: first four reference slots versus last four, within each world
metrics: sum of picked-up Food.value, excluding prey
thresholdRule: floor(reference-control calibration p05 * 20) / 20; no validation retuning
negativeChecks: survival threshold above idle/suicide calibration p95; food threshold above circle calibration p95
gate: lower endpoint of seed-block bootstrap 95% interval for mean paired ratio >= threshold for both metrics
samplingUnit: seed; average both rotated-world ratios within seed before resampling
replay: repeat seed 41001 and compare both worlds byte-for-byte
limits: synthetic same-build portable calibration; no outside servers, runtime deadlines, respawn capacity, combat or cross-platform bitwise claims
